overview_description.description: Regbase provides an AI-native regulatory intelligence platform that helps legal, compliance, and research teams track global regulatory developments. The software monitors draft bills, final rules, public consultations, enforcement moves, and regulator commentary across jurisdictions. It scans obscure local government sites, non-English sources, social media posts, and access-gated documents to capture laws and policy updates that are difficult to find. Regbase combines AI agents for search, translation, and analysis with human verification to reduce errors and link results to official legal texts. Users can ask natural language questions about obligations, deadlines, and penalties, receive citations to specific provisions, and configure alerts for changes. The platform also identifies grants and government funding opportunities relevant to clients’ sectors and compliance mandates. Regbase supports use cases in areas such as employment and labor, AI governance, healthcare, privacy, climate and sustainability, government procurement, private equity, and other regulated industries.
